method.method_draft: First describe the figure: a JK flip-flop is shown, J is at logic 1, K is at logic 0, and the clock input C receives a pulse. From the text, take the initial state as Q=0. Use the JK next-state equation Q_next = J·not(Q) + not(K)·Q. Substitute J=1, K=0, Q=0: Q_next = 1·1 + 1·0 = 1. Thus after the clock pulse the flip-flop state is 1.

Therefore, when the clock pulse C arrives, the flip-flop is set to state 1.
